messages:
incident-bot: PAGER - P1: hosted-api (us-east-1) p99/p95 latency spike + 5xx wave. Symptoms: request queue growth to ~12k, timeouts, customer errors. Root cause suspected: GPU pool saturation + autoscaler errors (QuotaExceeded). Runbook: https://runbook.internal/incidents/gpu-autoscale

Aaron: taking pager (oncall). I'm seeing 503s across customer probes, tail latencies at 18s, and queue depth creeping. Will post top affected orgs and start mitigations. ETA 2m to initial actions.

Julie: looking at autoscaler logs now. Cloud provider returned 403 QuotaExceeded at 13:02:11 UTC. Autoscaler retried, then exponential backoff; it never reached desired replica count. Stack: autoscaler->provisioner->cloud-api. Error snippet: ```ProvisionRequest failed: QuotaExceeded: GPUs requested (48) > quota (32)```. 

Maya: can we put a fast fallback in place? Idea: temporarily route non-enterprise traffic to gpt-small family or to eu-west overlay while autoscaler recovers. Also consider emergency rate-limits for free/tiered orgs.

Elaine: ticket intake - Customer A (enterprise, priority) reports ~30% failed jobs and doc generation timeouts. Customer B (freemium) also seeing timeouts. No status update yet; I'll draft a customer-facing note.

Aaron: doing an emergency soft-rate-limit for non-enterprise orgs: applying 50% reduction via /ops/ratelimits. Command: ```PATCH /config/ratelimits { "scope": "non-enterprise", "rate": 0.5 }``` Applying now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolling update for fallback-route-config started. 6/6 target services, 3/6 updated, 3 pending. Link: https://deploys.internal/runs/9876

Julie: because provider quota is blocking scale, forced scale on the same region will fail. Workaround: spinning up cold-standby overlay in eu-west-1 and adding a 25% session-level split. Command I ran: ```./ops route add --from hosted-api --to eu-west-overlay --weight 25 --tag emergency-fallback``` I also started the 'reserved-burst' warmup on dedicated pool (warmup request queueing). Logs: /logs/autoscaler/1729456789

Maya: opened an escalation with cloud provider (CS-786432). Asked for immediate temporary quota bump. Also enabling prioritized routing for enterprise orgs only.

Aaron: canary has started. Canary p95 for routed sessions to eu-west-1 is 1.1s. Global p95 dropped from 2.4s -> 1.9s since rate-limit+canary. Still seeing tail 5xx for some customers.

Elaine: statuspage update drafted: "Partial degradation in us-east-1 affecting hosted API; mitigations in progress. Some requests may error or be slower. We will update as we learn more." Posting in 5.

Julie: note: autoscaler should detect QuotaExceeded and automatically flip to alternate-region fallback. It didn't. That's a clear bug for postmortem—will file follow-up.

Aaron: provider response ETA ~2 hours per escalation. If they can't raise quota faster, next step is to shift more traffic to eu-west and enable longer-term rate-limits for non-critical flows.

Sam: I'm taking handoff at +30m (night-oncall). Please post a short actionable summary for me (what's running, what's been toggled, outstanding risks).

Julie: summary for handoff @Sam: 1) Emergency rate-limits applied to non-enterprise (50%). 2) Fallback routing 25% -> eu-west overlay. 3) Reserved-burst warmup started. 4) Provider quota escalation open CS-786432. 5) Autoscaler logs show QuotaExceeded; scaling blocked. Monitor /metrics/hosted/p95, /metrics/autoscaler/errors.

Maya: customer impact summary for handoff: Customer A (enterprise) - degraded, prioritized routing in place; Customer B (freemium) - degraded, rate-limited; other small orgs - throttled. Action items for night: 1) if provider doesn't approve quota, increase eu-west weight to 50% and reduce non-enterprise rate to 30%; 2) continue warmup of dedicated burst; 3) watch for increased cost when shifting region.

Sam: got it. I'll own until 08:00 UTC. If provider doesn't respond within 2 hours, I'll escalate CORS for automated region shift and open a cost approval with finance for cross-region bursts. Will keep update cadence every 15m.

Julie: for the post-incident follow-up: add an autoscaler policy to auto-fallback on quota errors, add a runbook step to automatically spin eu-west overlay if provision fails, and add better metrics around per-org queue depth.

Maya: thanks. Elaine - post the status update now. Aaron/Julie/Sam - please push any logs or short notes to the incident doc. I'll start the incident timeline and severity review after handoff.

Elaine: statuspage posted. Message: "Investigating: Hosted API in us-east-1 experiencing higher error rates and latencies due to GPU capacity exhaustion. Mitigations deployed. We'll provide updates every 30 minutes." Link: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1729456789

incident-bot: NOTE: escalation reminder set for +2h if cloud provider does not respond. Next update expected at 1729456889.

Sam: acknowledged. Taking over. If anyone needs me overnight ping @Sam directly. I'll update this thread on any major changes. Sam out.
